name: world-sync-extras
author: Lil Art
description: World Sync's playable content and iRO's missing quests, in blocks you can switch: the Jormungandr saga (Episodes 20 and 21 with their memorial dungeons, dailies and traders), Chapters 1 and 2 of the Song of the World Tree, Varmundt, the Star Emperor job change, Sanctuary Herosria and its Sunday siege, iRO services like the Devil in the Box, and iRO Quests: Bounty Boards, City Investment, Gramps and the 2021 town quests. The official NPCs still without logic stand where the clients put them, and @npcplace moves any NPC. Renewal, 1.6.7+.
